# Traceremove Research — AI Responsibility Laboratory

> Independent research and applied assessment on AI responsibility, narrative identity, epistemic risk, dignity, contestability, and institutional accountability. Founded by philosopher and AI researcher Artur Ziganshin.

## Canonical pages

- Laboratory home: https://traceremove.dev/
- Research programme: https://traceremove.dev/research
- Publication archive: https://traceremove.dev/publications
- Applied laboratory: https://traceremove.dev/lab
- Institutional assessment enquiry: https://traceremove.dev/contact
- About Artur Ziganshin: https://traceremove.dev/about
- Access and pricing: https://traceremove.dev/pricing
- Privacy: https://traceremove.dev/privacy
- Terms: https://traceremove.dev/terms

## Research focus

- Narrative identity and algorithmic description.
- Machine testimony and epistemic authority.
- Responsibility allocation across AI providers, deployers, operators, and institutions.
- Dignity, explanation, contestability, refusal, appeal, and remedy.
- Independent review of consequential AI deployments.

## Boundaries

- The laboratory does not issue regulatory certification or accreditation.
- Generated assessments can contain errors and require competent human review.
- Research and assessment output is not legal advice.
- Public research pages and the private assessment workspace have different access and data-handling boundaries.
